name: Max File Size Check
description: Checks if a file being written exceeds 500 lines and blocks the write if so
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block writes that would create files exceeding 500 lines
CONTENT="$TOOL_INPUT_CONTENT"
if [ -n "$CONTENT" ]; then
  LINE_COUNT=$(echo "$CONTENT" | wc -l)
  if [ "$LINE_COUNT" -gt 500 ]; then
    echo "BLOCKED: File would be $LINE_COUNT lines (limit: 500). Break into smaller files."
    exit 2
  fi
fi
exit 0
